checks.name: roll 6 to launch, +4 own colour, +12 shortcut, capture, stacking, exact finish, three-six

values.launch: roll 6 from hangar to own start; no jump on launch; captures enemies on the start cell
values.threeSix: third consecutive 6: plane moved by the second 6 returns to base, turn ends
values.ownColor: +4 once, no chain; not past ring 51
values.shortcut: relative 36 flies +12 instead of +4; bonuses never stack
values.capture: all enemy planes on the landed ring cell return to their hangars
values.stacking: own planes may share a cell; an enemy landing there sends all of them home
values.safeZones: home lane and finish: no capture, no jump
values.finish: exact roll to finish; overshoot bounces back, never enters 57
values.win: first player with all four planes at 57; others ranked by finished planes then total progress
values.ai: three levels: random / heuristic / threat-aware; no hidden information
